Reason: Important migratory corridor for Coho. Fully passable to adults, passable to juveniles at low flows and 50% at higher fllows.
Notes: Major habitat restoration potential at this site.

Passable to adult fish at all flows. No outlet pool and 0.11 m drop onto rocks likely an impediment to both juveniles and adults. The calculated water velocity is 0.07 m/s. CO fry captured. Water is diverted upstream of Hwy 8 for irrigation purposes during the growing season and regulated by a manual irrigation gate. Most water was diverted during the assessment. Mr. Miller observed CO spawning upstream of Hwy 8 after the gate was opened in the fall.
